page.overview:
What is What Comes When Light Gathers?

The Act 1 Interlude, or What Comes When Light Gathers , is a chapter in Dissidia Final Fantasy Opera Omnia. This chapter serves as the interlude between Act 1 and Act 2. This chapter was simply named "Interlude" in-game, but was given a chapter name for its story archive video.

Cait Sith from Final Fantasy VII can be recruited in this chapter.

See Dissidia Final Fantasy Opera Omnia Story Act 1 script#Interlude.
